convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic' custom indicator and depends on external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time calculation
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA starts processing

other_exits: Opposite crossover signal closes existing position when BuyPosClose or SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means MM is lot size; other modes interpret MM as fraction/percentage of deposit margin

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) with 2-element buffer copy comparing Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (2 bars ago) and Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] (1 bar ago) for crossover detection. Entry signals are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen booleans. Exit signals from opposite crossover are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans. Recount flag triggers recalculation on data issues. The custom indicator 'Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic' uses multiple smoothing methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh including JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA selectable via XMA_Method input.
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicator 'Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic' must be reimplemented in Python - it uses Chaikin Volatility with stochastic smoothing via SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA methods). The entry logic is a simple 2-buffer crossover on SignalBar=1 (previous bar), straightforward to replicate. Position sizing via TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be decoded - MM with MMMode=LOT is fixed lots, other MarginMode values need mapping. SL/TP are fixed pip values passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen - need to verify if these are point-based or pip-based (no 5-digit adjustment visible in code, so likely point-based already). Signal time tracking via UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime likely used for bar replay prevention in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
